# Arc Advanced Dentistry & Cosmetics

> > A comprehensive dental practice in Long Beach, NY offering cosmetic, restorative, and emergency dental services under the care of Dr. Deepa Jayam.

Arc Advanced Dentistry & Cosmetics is a full-service dental practice located in Long Beach, NY, led by Dr. Deepa Jayam who trained at University of Pennsylvania School of Dental Medicine and NYU College of Dentistry. The practice specializes in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, restorative procedures, and family dental care.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Veneers
